field_descriptions.amount_of_this_good: The quantity of the goods included in the offer.
field_descriptions.business_function: The business function (e.g. sell, lease, repair, dispose) of the offer or component of a bundle (TypeAndQuantityNode). The default is http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.type_of_good: The product that this structured value is referring to.
field_descriptions.unit_code: The unit of measurement given using the UN/CEFACT Common Code (3 characters) or a URL. Other codes than the UN/CEFACT Common Code may be used with a prefix followed by a colon.
field_descriptions.unit_text: A string or text indicating the unit of measurement. Useful if you cannot provide a standard unit code for unitCode.
